I have a question regarding SCT.

In the CoC, it is mentioned that I need to wait for 30 mins as the recording in the gmeet is running but as no proctor is in the meet so, no recording is running.

So what should I do in this case ?

posts.name: Sahla
posts.cooked:
Is it not necessary to set up VM for SCT?
And I have registered for two programming courses JAVA AND SC, So for both OPPE we have only one common SCT and for 30 mins right?

Hi,

Since OPPE will be on VM itself. So better set up your VM before doing the SCT.

Yes, SCT is same for all OPPE-based subjects.

Regards,

posts.name: Usha
posts.cooked:
Hello sir,
I have been trying to finish the SCT from 3 days. But no one is there in the gmeet provided in the calendar. Now also I have joined the gmeet but no one is responding. Should we do it on our own from the exam link provided?

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

Please read the instructions once again. You don’t have to report to anyone in the meet. Just stay there for a stipulated time period, and then upload whatever screenshots has been asked for. Yes, you have to do it on your own.

I hope this helps.

Regards,
Puneet
